verdict.rationale: Morph is an API and model platform, so a natural-language way to operate it is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no such capability: no assistant, console, or command interface that runs account, endpoint, or configuration actions from plain-language requests. The MCP server and coding-agent integrations expose Morph's editing and search tools to external agents, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
